name: b10_axe
title: Kart: axe strikes
note: b10's own strikes with the hatchet in her right hand and the pistols in her thigh holsters, as her game's battle stance has them (user 10-06: "把ROE中的卡地亚也加入战斗，一个拿斧子和枪的上衣是红色的卡地亚" - 卡地亚 is Kart, b10, in the fight since 10-03 but boxing with the motion pack's punches, her axe and pistols only in her skills). In her game she never holds the pistols: in her skills she throws the axe and the pistols fly by themselves and shoot - that stays in her skills. Picked from b10_axe_candidates.json (out/b10_axe_candidates.mp4): A the sweep of her own skill_01 (she throws the axe there; here it stays in her hand), B Vindictus' Attack_Strong01 overhead chop, C Attack_Strong02 lunging cut, D Attack04 the axe over the head and down into the ground (knocks down; Inase's C is the same motion). A-C are neither Fiona's nor Inase's. Each kept up to where the swing has settled ("to") and hits while the axe sweeps through the front ("hit", from RoeMotionPacks.Import -roeTips on b10 with the grip). All Mid by hand (measured at the axe's farthest point A is High and B Low). Her grip: tools/roe/b10_grip.json (RoeWeaponGrip; the pistols vanish with their holsters, burst stage 1). who / src / zh are notes for people and the videos.
